request: Activate the complete Kalaxy3 SAGE mandatory operating contract. Require current Git, GitHub, SAGE, and runtime authority before mutation; evidence-based selection and reuse of repository-owned components; composition manifests; capability-gap receipts; real runtime validation; failure diagnosis that records what failed, what should have been done, which existing component should have been used, why the actual path differed, and the reusable correction; measurable outcome, reuse, authority, failure, rework, and safety statistics; Git credential and history safety; and an operator-executed, visible, one-boundary-at-a-time Git/GitHub mutation gate. Downloaded implementation helpers may edit and validate repository files but may only inspect Git read-only and may not create or switch branches, stage, commit, push, pull, merge, rebase, reset, clean, delete refs, mutate GitHub, or deploy.
required_capability: Mode-preserving atomic repository file replacement with rollback.

candidates_considered.insufficiency: Helper-local writers are duplicated, unversioned, and previously changed an executable file to mode 0644.

gap.missing_interface_or_behavior: A reusable allowed-root writer with fsync, os.replace, mode preservation, symlink rejection, and snapshots.
gap.why_configuration_is_insufficient: Flags cannot make multiple helper-local implementations share one tested contract.
gap.why_composition_is_insufficient: Composing existing command and evidence primitives does not provide atomic file replacement semantics.

proposed_primitive.responsibility: Replace declared repository files atomically while preserving existing modes and supporting rollback.
proposed_primitive.idempotency: Identical input preserves identical content and existing mode.
proposed_primitive.logging: Caller records path and digest; content remains unlogged.
proposed_primitive.failure_mode: Out-of-root, symlink, write, fsync, replace, or rollback failure stops the transaction.

approval.rationale: The operator explicitly approved the Phase 2 least-authority safety-foundation gaps.
